title: SdlcStageStamp
description: Immutable append-only mark for an SDLC stage. Arm-agnostic so vanilla GSD (no tracker) and the recipe arm (tracker-linked) are both measurable on the same KPIs.

stamp_id.description: Unique id, e.g. uuid or tracker comment id

step.description: SDLC stage the mark belongs to

status.description: Lifecycle milestone reached at this stage

arm.description: Which experiment arm produced this stamp; required so KPIs compare across arms

actor.description: Who advanced the stage; powers the human-touch-ratio KPI

tracker.description: Optional. Present when a stage is linked to a live tracker issue (recipe arm). Vanilla GSD/baseline omit it.
